en.headline: Police arrest six after raiding Mong Kok baccarat gambling den
en.dek: Officers from the Mong Kok special duty squad busted a suspected illegal gambling establishment on Fa Yuen Street on Thursday, seizing a baccarat table, chips and cash.
body: Police said officers from the Mong Kok special duty squad carried out an anti-gambling operation codenamed FULLBOOM on Thursday and raided a unit on Fa Yuen Street.

They arrested a 65-year-old local woman on suspicion of managing a gambling establishment, a 20-year-old local man on suspicion of assisting in the management, and four other people aged 54 to 73 on suspicion of gambling in a gambling establishment. All were detained for investigation.

Officers seized a baccarat table, about HK$6,000 in cash, chips with a face value of about HK$130,000 and other gambling paraphernalia. Police reminded the public that managing a gambling establishment carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and seven years’ imprisonment under the Gambling Ordinance.

zh.headline: 旺角花園街百家樂賭檔被搔 警拘6人
zh.dek: 旺角特別職務隊周四突擊搜查花園街一個單位，搔破懷疑非法賭檔，檢獲百家樂枱、籌碼及現金，拘捕6人。
body: 警方表示，旺角特別職務隊人員周四展開代號「蓄勢」（FULLBOOM）的反賭博行動，突擊搜查花園街一個單位。
行動中，一名65歲姓駱本地女子涉嫌「管理賭博場所」被捕；一名20歲姓蕭本地男子涉嫌「協助管理賭博場所」被捕；另外一名本地男子及三名本地女子，年齡介乎54至73歲，則涉嫌「在賭博場所內賭博」被捕。所有被捕人現正被扣留調查。
警方檢獲一張百家樂枱、約6,000元現金、面值約13萬元的籌碼及一批賭具。警方重申，根據《賭博條例》，管理賭博場所一經定罪最高可判罰款500萬元及監禁7年。
更正：標題及內文已修正「搗」字錯字。
